verses.text: Someone who shuts everyone out chases their own wants and pushes back against every bit of sound judgment.
A fool gets no joy from understanding anything. They just want everyone to hear their opinion.
When wickedness walks in, contempt comes with it. Shame brings disgrace right along behind it.
A person's words are like deep waters. The spring of wisdom flows like a running stream.
It's wrong to give the wicked special treatment or cheat an innocent person out of justice.
A fool talks their way into a fight. Their mouth practically asks for a beating.
A fool's own mouth brings them down. Their words set a trap for their life.
Gossip goes down like a tasty little bite. It sinks deep inside you.
Someone who slacks off on the job is practically family to someone who goes around wrecking things.
The LORD's name is a strong tower. People who do right run to him and find safety.
A rich person's wealth is their fortified city. In their head, it's a wall nobody can climb.
A proud heart comes before a crash. Humility comes before honor.
Answer before you've heard someone out and you'll look foolish and bring shame on yourself.
Your spirit can carry you through sickness, but who can carry a spirit that's been crushed?
A heart with good judgment picks up knowledge. Wise ears are always listening to learn.
A gift can open doors for you and get you in front of important people.
The first person to tell their side sounds right until somebody else comes along and asks questions.
Casting lots can settle an argument and keep powerful opponents apart.
An offended brother is harder to win over than a fortified city. Arguments can shut you out like bars across a fortress gate.
Your stomach fills up with the fruit of what you say. The harvest of your words is what you'll live on.
The tongue has the power of life and death. People who love using it will eat whatever fruit it grows.
Finding a wife is finding a good thing and receiving favor from the LORD.
Poor people plead for mercy. The rich answer them harshly.
A person with a whole crowd of companions can still come to ruin. But there's a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
